    Recovery of central coefficients by two-sided multiplication #

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.coefficients_zero_of_sandwich_separation {T : Type u_1} {ι : Type u_2} {J : Type u_3} [Ring T] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype J] (b d : ι → T) (u v : ι → J → T) (hcomm : ∀ (i l : ι) (j : J), Commute (u l j) (d i)) (hsep : ∀ (l i : ι), ∑ j : J, u l j * b i * v l j = if i = l then 1 else 0) (h : ∑ i : ι, d i * b i = 0) (i : ι) :
    d i = 0

    Two-sided operators isolating the members of a basis recover the coefficients of a relation in any target ring. The coefficients need only commute with the left multipliers.

    source
    theorem EFiniteCharacterizations.ringHom_agree_on_separated_coefficients {A : Type u_1} {T : Type u_2} {ι : Type u_3} {J : Type u_4} [Ring A] [Ring T] [Fintype ι] [DecidableEq ι] [Fintype J] (f g : A →+* T) (b c : ι → A) (u v : ι → J → A) (hb : ∀ (i : ι), f (b i) = g (b i)) (hu : ∀ (l : ι) (j : J), f (u l j) = g (u l j)) (hc : ∀ (i l : ι) (j : J), Commute (u l j) (c i)) (hsep : ∀ (l i : ι), ∑ j : J, u l j * b i * v l j = if i = l then 1 else 0) (h : f (∑ i : ι, c i * b i) = g (∑ i : ι, c i * b i)) (i : ι) :
    f (c i) = g (c i)

    Agreement on a linear combination and the basis elements forces agreement on the coefficients when two-sided operators isolate each basis element and the maps agree on their left multipliers.
